test_asfreq_upsample_downsample: test DataFrame and Series asfreq method to upsample or downsample time series data between frequencies
test_asfreq_with_fill_value: test asfreq method with fill_value parameter to fill missing values during upsampling
test_asfreq_normalize: test asfreq method with normalize=True to strip time components from DatetimeIndex
test_asfreq_period_index: test asfreq method on PeriodIndex dataframes with how parameter for start or end conversion
test_asfreq_invalid_frequency: test asfreq raises ValueError for deprecated frequency aliases like 2M, 2Q, 2A
